How it works

A clear path,
from idea to home

Five considered stages, with decisions made together. Timing is agreed around your project, materials and workshop capacity.

Our process

Good work begins with understanding

At every stage, you know what we are working on and what needs your approval.

01

Consultation

We begin with listening

Tell us about your room, routines and priorities. Bring photographs, inspiration and an approximate budget.

What happens at this stage

What you receive

A shared brief covering priorities, budget and scope.

What we need from you

Your ideas, photographs and existing plans.

02

Measurement

Every millimetre has a purpose

We measure the room, check levels and note openings and service positions. Access and installation conditions become part of the plan.

What happens at this stage

What you receive

A measured design basis and technical points to resolve.

What we need from you

Access to the room and details of planned building work.

03

Design

A clear proposal, made together

Layouts, visualisations and samples turn the brief into a design. We review the details together before production is approved.

What happens at this stage

What you receive

An agreed design, material selections and itemised quotation.

What we need from you

Feedback on layouts, finishes and final drawings.

04

Production

Care at every stage of making

The approved design moves into preparation, cutting, joinery and finishing. We check components and coordinate the installation sequence.

What happens at this stage

What you receive

Furniture prepared to the approved specification.

What we need from you

Confirmation of final choices and an installation-ready room.

05

Installation

The final fit, and the life after

We fit the furniture, align fronts and hardware, and explain care and use. Remaining adjustments are recorded at handover.

What happens at this stage

What you receive

Installed furniture, care guidance and a documented handover.

What we need from you

Clear access, a prepared workspace and time for a final walkthrough.
